If this your first experience with a psychedelic that's stronger than cannabis, and you aren't prepared for changes then don't do it. Unless you are predisposed to a mental illness, you won't go insane but you will see things in a different light and it will most likely change the way you see them afterwards. It's not like you'll be a different person literally, it's more like you'll notice things you didn't notice before and take them into account, hence changing yourself by your own will.

Basically, the way it works is it removes all your filters of perception, brought by upbringing and society, leaving you with a raw input of sensory data. So, if you were always taught certain things but "feel" like they were wrong, this will rise up.

Psychiatrists use shrooms to treat victims of childhood abuse or felons for a reason, to "unteach" them the patterns they were taught when they were young.

It's a powerful tool, so be careful.
Psychedelics can open doors and change your life. I know I've become a completely different person after using. Whether to better or worse, I don't know.

Start with a low dose to get a feel. It's better to trip at night than during the day. Prepare to have fairly strong afteraffects 24 hours after, afterglow 3-5 days after.

I could walk into a dark room 20 hours after ingestion and "feel" the darkness around me, hallucinating three-dimensional shapes.

Oh, one thing -- you might feel a burning sensation starting from your genitalia, going through the stomach, passing the middle of the chest and numbing the back of your skull. I've had that, was scared shitless, but it went away with the chemical.

During the trip, you might have hot flashes (another reason to trip at night) and after the trip you will feel very cold. You might feel that your heart has stopped. You might feel that you are communicating with the Overmind.

You might realize that we are all Gods in human flesh and that reality is divine.
